verification.notes: Searches found public speculation about Shapiro father using pseudonyms, but no reliable source identifying Hank Berrien as his father. Available biographical material has associated a different pseudonym, William Bigelow, with Shapiro father. The statement is therefore retained explicitly as Owens allegation, not treated as established fact.
